tools.name: rental-operations_deposit-payment-evidence-check
tools.description: Compare deposit evidence with the expected amount, currency, and reference. A matching screenshot is still not treated as cleared funds. Price $0.04 USDC. POST /api/v1/rental-operations/deposit-payment-evidence-check. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: rental-operations_first-rent-payment-check
tools.description: Compare first-rent evidence with the expected amount, currency, and reference. A payment instruction is not treated as cleared funds. Price $0.04 USDC. POST /api/v1/rental-operations/first-rent-payment-check. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: rental-operations_tenancy-document-completeness
tools.description: List the document kinds the caller marked as required and which of them were supplied. A jurisdiction name does not add a legal checklist. Price $0.04 USDC. POST /api/v1/rental-operations/tenancy-document-completeness. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: rental-operations_move-in-inventory-compare
tools.description: Compare a baseline inventory with the move-in list by room, name, condition, and count. A difference is not a finding of liability. Price $0.05 USDC. POST /api/v1/rental-operations/move-in-inventory-compare. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: rental-operations_tenant-document-expiry-check
tools.description: Compare supplied expiry dates with a supplied as-of date. No as-of date means expiry is not judged, and a document number is reduced to its last four characters. Price $0.04 USDC. tools.name: rental-operations_tenancy-obligation-extract
tools.description: Copy labeled obligations, the stated party, and a real due date. The wording is not treated as legal advice or an eviction right. Price $0.04 USDC. POST /api/v1/rental-operations/tenancy-obligation-extract. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "rental-operations" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: rental-operations_tenant-move-in-readiness, rental-operations_deposit-payment-evidence-check, rental-operations_first-rent-payment-check, rental-operations_tenancy-document-completeness, rental-operations_move-in-inventory-compare, rental-operations_tenant-document-expiry-check · Private data: rental-operations_tenancy-document-completeness, rental-operations_tenant-document-expiry-check, rental-operations_handover-report · Public sink: rental-operations_tenant-move-in-readiness, rental-operations_deposit-payment-evidence-check, rental-operations_first-rent-payment-check, rental-operations_tenancy-document-completeness, rental-operations_move-in-inventory-compare, rental-operations_tenant-document-expiry-check, rental-operations_tenancy-obligation-extract, rental-operations_handover-report · Destructive: rental-operations_tenant-move-in-readiness, rental-operations_deposit-payment-evidence-check, rental-operations_first-rent-payment-check, rental-operations_tenancy-document-completeness, rental-operations_move-in-inventory-compare, rental-operations_tenant-document-expiry-check, rental-operations_tenancy-obligation-extract, rental-operations_handover-report.

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
